dict.string: Newtv1 listens to your voice commands only while you turn on listening.
Newtv1 transcribes your voice to control your Mac. On-device recognition is required unless you explicitly allow Apple network recognition.
Newtv1 uses Apple events to show Spotify and Apple Music track details and control playback when you connect media, and to change volume when you ask.
Newtv1 shows a local camera mirror only when you start it. Video is not recorded or uploaded.
Newtv1 shows upcoming events from calendars you select in the notch.
Newtv1 reads upcoming events from calendars you select. Calendar contents are not sent to AI.
